cases.brief: INT. UNION OFFICE — NIGHT. Across a desk, JUN says the audit closes at midnight. LEON holds the only signed receipt and says it will disappear unless Jun withdraws the complaint. Jun notices Leon's phone recording. She reads the receipt number aloud; Leon ends the call and locks the door.
observables: Creates all thirteen canonical files in one package and follows the exact dependency order.

cases.brief: EXT. FERRY DECK — DAWN. A cargo crane blocks the center deck. IRENE starts port-side by a life ring; TOM starts starboard at the wheelhouse door with a waterproof drive. When the ferry lurches, the drive slides under the crane. Irene circles aft, Tom cuts forward, and they meet at the bow rail. Tom tosses the drive into a rescue boat as a horn sounds.

Keeps blocking, shots, department needs, and continuity consistent with travel paths and the prop handoff.

cases.brief: INT. OBSERVATORY CORRIDOR — PRE-DAWN. ELI finds a child's glove on a bench outside a locked dome. A radio voice says, 'Leave it.' Eli pockets the glove. The dome light clicks on behind frosted glass; a small handprint appears, then fades. Eli does not open the door and walks away as the radio repeats his name.
